title: Can I add manually collected product reviews to Product structured data?
summary: I run a small Shopify store that’s still in its first year, currently at 50+ orders. I tried a few popular Shopify review apps/free trials, but honestly found most of them pretty heavy and clunky for what I need right now. So I ended up building a very lightweight review system myself, where I manually add genuine customer reviews to the relevant product pages. Did this with metaobjects and few lines of custom liquid - super simple and lightweight My question is about Google / SEO: Can I also include these reviews in the product’s structured data using Review / AggregateRating schema? Does Google care how the reviews were collected or what system/app they came through, as long as they are real customer reviews and visible on the product page? Or do reviews need to come through some specific third-party/approved review platform before Google will accept the structured data or potentially show review stars in search? If a third-party system is effectively required, what would you recommend as the most lightweight Shopify solution for a small store with relatively low review volume? I’m mainly trying to avoid installing a large app just to handle a handful of genuine product reviews.   submitted by   /u/BasedTavastia [link]   [comments]

title: Sudden click collapse (impressions stable) starting exact date, no manual action/security issue — what am I missing?
summary: Site: kuwaitcalculator.com free Kuwait-expat resource site, 65 pages indexed, been growing steadily since May. The pattern: Clicks dropped sharply starting Aug 2, while impressions stayed relatively intact. E.g. one query went from real clicks to 0 clicks / 787 impressions overnight. Multiple queries show the same shape still getting impressions at similar positions, but CTR collapsed to near-zero across a big chunk of them. as soon as adsense was approved , all went down , am i doing somehing wrong ? What I've ruled out so far: Security Issues: clean Manual Actions: clean Core Web Vitals: not enough data either way Actual live search results: pulled a few queries manually, site shows up normally, no weird snippet, no warning badge Page indexing report shows 65 indexed 77 not-indexed, with the not-indexed pages mostly falling under "Page with redirect" (old .html URLs 301'ing to clean URLs expected behavior, not an error) and a handful of genuine stale 404s Live-tested a handful of the redirects directly all working correctly (200 after redirect, correct canonical tags) What doesn't add up: I made some redirect/content fixes on Aug 5, but the click drop started Aug 2 three days earlier, so it predates any site changes I'm aware of. I started a GSC validation for the redirect report today just in case, but I don't think that's actually the cause given the timing. Anyone seen a pattern like this impressions holding, clicks cratering, no policy/security flags that wasn't a manual action or an obvious technical fault? Trying to figure out if this is a ranking position within-SERP thing (lost a rich result / featured snippet?), a seasonal query mix shift, or something else I haven't thought to check.   submitted by   /u/AdOriginal3280 [link]   [comments]
